title: About Obsolete Guidebook Marquee
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 529 recent saved-signal files and 182 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @nineten: Interesting early PC art made for the "complete guidebook of MOTHER", showing what I... and @mattshumer_: Claude Fable can run autonomously for days. This is the single highest-leverage..., plus 4 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Obsolete Guidebook Marquee: Obsolete guidebook street-glass plate, poster crop, browserless media shrine: hold a vast faded cyan-periwinkle field on the left, nearly empty except hairline lamps and road flecks; compress the right edge into a stacked brick, cream marquee, yellow paper, and enamel sign spine. Use scan grain, blocky illegible red... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against vast cyan sky-glass field at left, tall cream enamel marquee face, and deep black sign-side gutter.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
